name: Dynamic front [deprecated]
description: Redirects the front page to the first administrator-configured URL the current user has access to (obsolete; use dynamic_links).
project_description:
This module will be useful for sites where users have multiple roles and the main page should differ depending on access.

 For example, you can configure multiple views with different accesses, and this module will redirect the user to the first available view.

 Features 
 Provides the ability to configure a dynamic home page, opening the first one the user has access to.

 Post-Installation 
 After installation, go to /admin/config/system/dynamic-front, fill out the form and save.

 * A dynamic front page requires the "View dynamic front" permission, which you must grant to the authenticated user.
